response.justification: Bogdan has extensive full-stack experience with TypeScript, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL-like SQL databases, and his work on scalable systems and AI-agent infrastructure aligns with the role’s needs; however, his seniority far exceeds the entry-level requirement, his German language skill is basic despite high on-site presence being required, and his resume leans heavily on niche languages (DLang) and outdated tech, raising concerns about focus and adaptability to the domain.
strengths: Strong TypeScript and React experience across multiple production systems
Proven full-stack ownership from database to UI with scalable architecture
Active contributor to open-source and AI-agent tooling with modern workflows
concerns: Senior-level experience far exceeds entry-level role, risking misalignment or turnover
Basic German proficiency conflicts with high on-site presence requirement
Over-reliance on niche languages (DLang) and fragmented tech stack may indicate lack of focus
